_comment: Optional metadata overrides for style files in styles/. Any .xsl file NOT listed here is still listed on the website automatically — its display name is parsed from the file itself and its filename is humanized. Add an entry here only to customize the name, summary, features or category. Allowed categories: author-date, numeric, custom, general.

APASeventhEdition.xsl.name: APA Seventh Edition
APASeventhEdition.xsl.summary: The current APA 7th edition style with author–date citations and a hanging-indent reference list.
features: Handles DOIs, URLs, and up to 20 authors

APASixthEditionOfficeOnline.xsl.name: APA Sixth Edition
APASixthEditionOfficeOnline.xsl.summary: APA 6th edition references for social and behavioral sciences.

CHICAGO.XSL.name: Chicago
CHICAGO.XSL.summary: Chicago author-date references for academic writing.

GB.XSL.name: GB/T 7714
GB.XSL.summary: Chinese national standard GB/T 7714 numeric references.

GostName.XSL.name: GOST — Name Sort
GostName.XSL.summary: Russian GOST standard references sorted by author name.

GostTitle.XSL.name: GOST — Title Sort
GostTitle.XSL.summary: Russian GOST standard references sorted by title.

HarvardAnglia2008OfficeOnline.xsl.name: Harvard Anglia
HarvardAnglia2008OfficeOnline.xsl.summary: Harvard Anglia 2008 references with author-date citations.

IEEE2006OfficeOnline.xsl.name: IEEE
IEEE2006OfficeOnline.xsl.summary: The standard Word IEEE numeric citation style.
features: Supports books, articles, websites, and reports

IEEE_with_DOI.xsl.name: IEEE with DOI
IEEE_with_DOI.xsl.summary: Modern IEEE numerical references with clickable DOI and website links.
features: Clickable DOI identifiers and doi.org links
Website fallback when no DOI is available
Numeric in-text citations and bibliography order
